Auricore Appoints New Chief Operating Officer Amid Growth Plans

Auricore Resources, a leading player in Guernsey’s metals and mining sector, has announced the appointment of Helen St. Clair as its new Chief Operating Officer, effective immediately. The move comes as the company seeks to expand its operational footprint across the Channel Islands and further diversify its mineral portfolio.

St. Clair, who brings over two decades of experience in resource management and operational leadership, previously served as COO at IsleMetals Group, where she oversaw several successful exploration projects in Western Europe. Her appointment is seen as a strategic decision to strengthen Auricore’s executive team during a period of sustained demand for base and precious metals.

“We are delighted to welcome Helen to Auricore,” said CEO Mark Linwood in a statement on Tuesday. “Her track record in optimizing mining operations and her commitment to sustainable practices align closely with our growth ambitions and environmental values.”

Industry analysts have responded positively to the announcement, noting the importance of experienced leadership as mining companies face evolving regulatory and market landscapes. “St. Clair’s leadership comes at a critical time, with Guernsey’s metals sector benefiting from stable commodity prices and increasing interest from international investors,” said Sophie Bertrand, senior analyst at Channel Islands Mining Forum.

The Guernsey Mining Association also commented on the appointment, emphasizing the significance of skilled talent in driving innovation and operational excellence within the local industry. “Helen’s extensive background will undoubtedly contribute to the continued success of Auricore and the wider mining community here in Guernsey,” stated Association Chair Peter Rowe.

Auricore reported steady year-on-year revenue growth in its latest financial results and is expected to provide further updates on its strategic initiatives later this year.
